terra.problem: The text does not say Ananias distrusted his own ability to speak or hired Tertullus.
The joke makes fun of how the names sound, which Papa Dorin's rules prohibit.
The explanation assumes what the accusers believed and makes an unsupported claim about what people would do in that situation.
Tertullus says they seized Paul, but the text does not say whether they sent a note or waited for a reply.
The text says the Jews concurred, but it does not say they nodded.
Calling Paul calm states a feeling the text does not give.
The explanation attributes a hope about the calendar to Paul without marking it as a guess.
The calendar joke does not click: people can check a calendar to confirm when a shopping trip happened.
The claim that a person protesting would not say what Paul said is not established by the text.
Paul gives his reasons for returning, but the text does not say he came with the intention of not starting a fight.
The explanation connects Paul's stated reasons for returning to Jerusalem directly to why he was in the temple, a connection the text does not explicitly make.
The text does not state that Paul returned with the intention of not starting a fight.
Paul says he was ceremonially clean and was not inciting a crowd or an uproar. That does not establish that he was keeping quiet.
“The card said” refers to the lesson's question rather than speaking naturally to the baker.
The drawer reference does not explain that Papa Dorin himself spent time there, so a baker unfamiliar with his story may miss the comparison.
Felix orders the centurion to keep Paul under guard, but the text does not say soldiers were forbidden to minister to his needs.
The explanation is flat and repetitive: its final sentence merely restates that the helpers were Paul's friends.
Felix tells Paul to leave; the text does not say Felix leaves the room. It also does not state that Felix was not angry.
The claim that a convinced person would not say what Felix said rules out a possibility the text leaves open.
The text says Felix hoped for a bribe, but it does not say he was not also waiting for a confession.
